## Download the data
The latest EPI CPS extracts are available in Stata format:

::: {.callout-note}
Due to the 2025 U.S federal government shutdown, October data was not collected and is not available in the EPI CPS extracts.
:::

Extract     | Years   | File | Version
------------|---------|------|---------------------------------
CPS Basic monthly | 1976 - {{< var latestdata >}} | [epi_cpsbasic_2000_{{< var dataendyear >}}.zip](https://microdata.epi.org/epi_cpsbasic_2000_{{< var dataendyear >}}.zip) <br/> [epi_cpsbasic_1976_1999.zip](https://microdata.epi.org/epi_cpsbasic_1976_1999.zip) | {{< var version >}}
CPS May           | 1973 - 1981            | [epi_cpsmay_1973_1981.zip](https://microdata.epi.org/epi_cpsmay_1973_1981.zip) | {{< var version >}}
CPS ORG           | 1979 - {{< var latestdata >}} | [epi_cpsorg_1979_{{< var dataendyear >}}.zip](https://microdata.epi.org/epi_cpsorg_1979_{{< var dataendyear >}}.zip) | {{< var version >}}

## Citations
If you use the EPI extracts for your research, please cite the data in your references:

::: {.callout-note title="Suggested citation for EPI microdata extracts"}
Economic Policy Institute. {{< var year >}}. Current Population Survey Extracts, Version {{< var version >}}, https://microdata.epi.org.
:::

The code that creates the EPI extracts and documentation is available on
[Github](https://github.com/Economic/epiextracts).
